heatsink_fins.title: Stamped Aluminum Fin Stack
heatsink_fins.description: Dense matrix of 48 stamped aluminum cooling fins featuring micro-louvered turbulence dimples and folded interlocking edge tabs.

heatpipes.title: Direct-Contact Copper Heatpipes
heatpipes.description: Four 6mm sintered copper U-shaped vapor chambers utilizing phase-change thermodynamics to rapidly lift heat from the base into the fin array.

copper_base.title: Nickel-Plated Copper Baseplate
copper_base.description: Precision CNC-machined copper base block with a micro-convex mirror finish ensuring uniform contact pressure over the CPU heat spreader.

cooling_fan.title: 120mm PWM High-Static Pressure Fan
cooling_fan.description: Fluid dynamic bearing 9-blade cooling fan engineered to push high-pressure laminar airflow through tight heatsink fin gaps.

fan_clips.title: Spring-Steel Fan Retention Clips
fan_clips.description: Dual heat-treated spring steel wire brackets securing the 120mm fan tightly into the recessed side grooves of the heatsink tower.

mounting_bracket.title: Crossbar Mounting Bridge
mounting_bracket.description: Reinforced steel crossbar clamp featuring dual spring-tensioned captive screws delivering standardized mounting downforce.

anti_vibration_pads.title: Silicone Anti-Vibration Dampeners
anti_vibration_pads.description: Molded elastomeric corner pads isolating mechanical motor harmonics and preventing resonance transmission into the aluminum fins.

pwm_cable.title: 4-Pin PWM Fan Lead Cable
pwm_cable.description: Braided black wiring harness terminating in a standardized 4-pin motherboard fan header plug with tachometer RPM feedback.

top_fin_shroud.title: Anodized Top Cover & Pipe Caps
top_fin_shroud.description: Brushed black anodized aluminum top plate with stealth copper heatpipe termination caps providing premium aesthetics.

thermal_paste_layer.title: Pre-Applied Thermal Compound
thermal_paste_layer.description: Micro-thin cross-hatch layer of high-conductivity non-curing thermal paste filling microscopic surface voids between base and IHS.
